props.title: What Is Deep Tissue Massage?
props.text: Deep tissue massage uses slow, firm pressure to work into the deeper layers of muscle. Unlike a gentler relaxing massage, it is meant for areas that feel stiff from exercise, repetitive movement, posture or long hours sitting. The controlled pressure eases tension and leaves you feeling looser.
props.feature1Text: Targets areas where long-term tension and stiffness commonly develop.
props.feature2Text: Uses steady techniques adjusted to your body's response and comfort level.

props.title: Choose Your Duration
props.text: The right session length depends on your treatment goals and the number of areas requiring attention. Shorter sessions work well for focused areas, while longer sessions allow more time for detailed muscle work.

props.title: When Deep Tissue Massage Helps
props.text: Guests choose a deep tissue massage when a regular massage doesn't reach the tension that keeps coming back. It's popular with active travellers and office workers. Main reasons to book one:
featuresLeft: Relieving the feeling of tight muscles
Feeling looser and easier to move
Targeting common areas of muscle tension
featuresRight: Relaxing the body after physical activities or long journeys
Loosening stiff areas caused by daily habits

props.title: Areas We Focus On
props.text: We usually focus on areas strained by posture, repetitive movement or exercise, such as:
featuresLeft: Shoulders and upper back from desk work or travel
Neck area affected by daily posture
featuresRight: Legs after walking, surfing, or exercise
Any area you ask us to focus on

props.title: How Deep Tissue Massage Works
props.text: Your therapist combines several hands-on techniques on areas of tension and stiffness, choosing the technique and pressure for each area. Common techniques include:
featuresLeft: Sustained pressure for deeper muscle work
Slow stripping techniques along muscle fibres
featuresRight: Forearm and elbow methods when suitable

items.question: Does a deep tissue massage hurt?
items.answer: A deep tissue massage may feel intense, especially when working on tight muscles, but it should remain within your comfort level. At Spa Bali Moon, the massage uses slow, firm pressure, and our therapists adjust it throughout the session based on your feedback. Tell your therapist straight away if any pressure feels too strong.

items.question: What's the difference between Swedish and deep tissue massage?
items.answer: Swedish massage uses lighter to moderate pressure and gentle, flowing movements to promote relaxation. Deep tissue massage uses firmer, slower pressure to target deeper muscle tension and tight areas.

items.question: Is a deep tissue massage good after exercise?
items.answer: Yes. Many active guests choose a deep tissue massage at Spa Bali Moon after physical activities because it focuses on areas that feel tight or overworked, such as legs after walking, surfing or exercise. Choose 1 hour for focused areas or 1.5 hours for several tight areas.

items.question: How often should I get a deep tissue massage?
items.answer: As often as your muscles need it: some guests at Spa Bali Moon book a deep tissue massage after surfing or exercise, others make it a regular part of their routine. For a first session, 1 hour suits focused work on the neck, shoulders or back.

items.question: Can I have a deep tissue massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon offers deep tissue massage as home service at your villa, hotel or home, for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Your therapist brings fresh linen, oils and everything the massage needs.

items.question: What should I do after a deep tissue massage?
items.answer: Drink plenty of water, rest, and avoid strenuous exercise for the rest of the day after your deep tissue massage. Gentle stretching can also help your muscles recover. If you book Spa Bali Moon's home service, the massage comes to your villa or hotel, so you can rest straight away without travelling back.

items.question: Is a deep tissue massage good for sciatica?
items.answer: It may ease the muscle tension that often comes with sciatica, but it is not a treatment for sciatica itself, so see a healthcare professional if your symptoms are severe or persistent. At Spa Bali Moon, mention your symptoms before the session so your therapist can adjust the pressure.

items.question: What are the benefits of a deep tissue massage?
items.answer: A deep tissue massage eases muscle tension and stiffness, especially after exercise, and leaves you feeling looser and more relaxed. At Spa Bali Moon, it typically focuses on the shoulders, neck, lower back, legs and arms.

items.question: How much does a deep tissue massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: IDR 269.000 for 1 hour and IDR 359.000 for 1.5 hours per person at Spa Bali Moon. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. For two people, a couple deep tissue massage costs IDR 539.000 for 1 hour or IDR 719.000 for 1.5 hours.

items.question: How long does a deep tissue massage take?
items.answer: A deep tissue massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 1 hour (IDR 269.000) or 1.5 hours (IDR 359.000) per person.

items.question: Can I book a deep tissue massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my deep tissue massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your deep tissue massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
